name: Day Theming (Cognitive Mode Categorization)
diagnostic: Macro context-switching fatigue. Alternating between diametrically opposed cognitive modes (e.g., deep analytical programming and interpersonal negotiations) on the same day degrades performance across both.

procedure.text: Sort commitments into three or four macro modes (e.g. Building, Operations, Team, Strategy).
Give each working day one dominant theme.
Batch each mode's tasks onto its assigned day.
Refuse or move requests that would pull a conflicting mode onto a themed day.

trap: Letting automated booking links scatter 30-minute meetings across days reserved for deep analytical work.
procedureFull:
1. Map all personal and professional commitments into 3–4 macro categories (e.g., Architecture/Building, Operations/Admin, Team/Mentorship, Strategy/Learning).
2. Assign each day of the working week a single dominant theme.
3. Batch all tasks belonging to a specific category exclusively into their assigned calendar day.
4. Reject or reschedule requests that force dissonant cognitive tasks into dedicated focus days.
setupFull:
Weekly Cognitive Theming Matrix
  * Monday: Internal Architecture & Deep Development (No internal meetings)
  * Tuesday: Client / Cross-functional Meetings & Collaboration
  * Wednesday: Systems Building & Heavy Refactoring (No meetings)
  * Thursday: Operations, Administrative Triage, Code Reviews
  * Friday: Strategy, Systems Retrospective, Weekly GTD Review
trapFull: Permitting external interruptions or scheduling tools (e.g., automated booking links) to scatter fragmented 30-minute meetings across days dedicated to deep analytical output.
